title: Revise hierarchical tone steps and press-depth rhythm for tokens, buttons, tables, and charts
creator: Maya Lopez
description: Consolidate token updates across color, type, spacing/radius, and elevation so the design system provides predictable behavior for dense data surfaces and interactive controls. Deliverables: (1) a hierarchical tonal ramp with explicit contrast anchors for primary/secondary/neutral roles; (2) a two-mode typography scale (regular + compact) with explicit line-height deltas; (3) proportional spacing and radius tokens that preserve minimum touch targets; (4) a simplified shadow/elevation grammar that maps to component press depth and table/chart overlays.
acceptance_criteria: All tokens published as JSON and CSS variables in the tokens registry and consumed by storybook builds.
Color ramps include WCAG AA contrast anchors for body/labels and an optional AAA anchor for small text; visual QA checklist passes for key flows (dashboard, table dense rows, chat).
Typography scale exported for both regular and compact modes; component stories reflect both and pass visual regression tests.
Spacing and radius tokens are responsive (scale-ratio) and preserve 44x44mm equivalent touch area for interactive controls regardless of density mode.
Elevation/shadow grammar reduced to three pragmatic levels (base, raised, pressed) with explicit mapping to button press depth and table row hover/selected states.
Migration guide + automated codemod created and linked; engineering has a rollout plan with a canary across console routes.
tasks: Finalize color ramp proposals and lock contrast anchors (Design)
Prototype typography scale and edge-case microcopy sizes (Design)
Author tokens JSON + CSS variable exports (Design + Platform)
Update Storybook stories for components: Button, Table, DataCard, Chart overlays (Platform)
Create migration PR with codemod and storybook diff automation (Engineering)
Run accessibility audit and capture results in QA checklist (QA)
Coordinate release notes and developer-facing token guide (Docs + Design)
design_assets: Figma: token snapshots + compact vs regular comps (frame 'Token Matrix')
decisions: Adopt proportional spacing scale (modular ratio 1.25) to reduce token variants while preserving rhythm.
Limit elevation system to three levels to simplify runtime kernel heuristics and avoid subtle cross-platform shadow differences.
Introduce token aliases for backward compatibility; deprecated tokens will remain for two releases with automated codemod.
Compact typography mode will be opt-in per route via console config and documented for Dedicated/Private customers.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Maya Lopez: Initial comps uploaded to Figma. Explorations include chroma-preserving ramps and denser table row variants.
2026-02-27 - Jonah Kim: Engineering feasibility reviewed. Kernel constraints mean we should avoid fractional shadow layers; propose 3 discrete elevations.
2026-03-03 - Priya Singh (Accessibility): Contrast anchors look good for main flows but small-footnote copy in tables needs AAA guidance or an alternative token.
2026-03-09 - Design Review: Consensus to keep proportional radius tokens tied to spacing scale; requested migration doc and codemod before eng rollout.
2026-03-11 - Jonah Kim: Draft PR created (see links). Storybook updates show regressions on nested card shadows — follow-up task created.
notes: Trade-offs: reducing token count improves cognitive load for engineers but requires careful visual QA to avoid introducing perceived flatness on analytics surfaces.
Rollout plan: canary on ~10% of console routes -> monitor cost/latency dashboard for any unexpected rendering regressions -> full rollout after 2 weeks of stable metrics.
